sections.description:
Amendment of section 16, Act XXXV of 1973

ACT LII OF 1975
ACT LII OF 1975
LEGAL
PRACTITIONERS AND BAR COUNCILS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An act further to
amend the Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1973
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 26th July 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on 4he 21st July 1915, and is
hereby published for general information:
2. Amendment of section 16,
Act XXXV of 1973.-In the Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1973
(XXXV of 1973), in section 16,
for clauses (a) and (b) the following shall be substituted, namely:-
"(a) in the case of the Pakistan Bar Council, the
vacancy shall be filled by a person elected in accordance with the provisions
of section 11; and
(b) in the case of a Provincial
Bar Council, the vacancy shall be filled by the person who received, in the
same election and from the same district or, as the case may be, group of
districts, the highest number of votes next after the member the vacancy in
whose seat is to be filled, or if there be no such person, by a person eligible
for election to that Council from the same district or, as, the case may be,
group of districts who is co-opted by the Provincial Bar Council. ".
